package consumer

import (
	"bytes"
	"context"

	"github.com/progresshans/godj/db/postgres"
	"github.com/progresshans/godj/db/sqlite"
	"github.com/progresshans/godj/migrations/backend"
	"github.com/progresshans/godj/migrations/definition"
	"github.com/progresshans/godj/project"
)

type migrationBackend struct{}

type migrationSQLRenderer struct{}

func (migrationSQLRenderer) RenderForwardMigrationSQL(context.Context, backend.ForwardMigrationSQLRequest) ([]string, error) {
	return []string{"SELECT 1"}, nil
}

func (*migrationBackend) MigrationCapabilities() backend.MigrationCapabilities {
	return backend.MigrationCapabilities{}
}
func (*migrationBackend) OpenRevisionFencedSession(context.Context) (backend.RevisionFencedSession, error) {
	return nil, nil
}
func (*migrationBackend) Close() error { return nil }

var _ project.MigrationBackend = (*migrationBackend)(nil)
var _ backend.MigrationSQLRenderer = migrationSQLRenderer{}
var _ func() backend.MigrationSQLRenderer = sqlite.NewMigrationSQLRenderer
var _ func(postgres.MigrationSQLConfig) backend.MigrationSQLRenderer = postgres.NewMigrationSQLRenderer

func sqliteProjectConfig() project.Config {
	return project.Config{MigrationSQLRenderer: sqlite.NewMigrationSQLRenderer()}
}

func postgresProjectConfig() project.Config {
	return project.Config{
		MigrationSQLRenderer: postgres.NewMigrationSQLRenderer(postgres.MigrationSQLConfig{Schema: "product_schema"}),
	}
}

func checkProjectRuntime() error {
	return project.Run(
		context.Background(),
		project.Config{
			MigrationDefinitionRoots: []string{"migrations"},
			MigrationDefinitionSources: []definition.Source{{
				SourceID: "framework/system-state.godj.json",
				Document: []byte(`{"format_version":1}`),
			}},
			OpenMigrationBackend: func(context.Context) (project.MigrationBackend, error) {
				return new(migrationBackend), nil
			},
			MigrationSQLRenderer: migrationSQLRenderer{},
		},
		[]string{"__godj_project_runner_v1"},
		bytes.NewBufferString(`{"protocol_version":1,"command":"migrations.check"}`),
		new(bytes.Buffer),
	)
}
